speaker: Narrator
text: Welcome to Zuri Home Supplies, a growing homeware shop in Nairobi. The shop has started using Smart Ledger, a system that posts each transaction to the accounts automatically.
spoken: Welcome to Zuri Home Supplies, a growing homeware shop in Nairobi. The shop has started using Smart Ledger, a system that posts each transaction to the accounts automatically.

speaker: Grace
text: The system records everything for me now. But the trial balance does not balance, and I cannot tell whether the postings are right.
spoken: The system records everything for me now. But the trial balance does not balance, and I cannot tell whether the postings are right.

speaker: Narrator
text: You are joining Grace as a junior accounts systems assistant. Here is the plan: set the posting rules, trace the errors in the ledger, then test the fixes and hand over.
spoken: You are joining Grace as a junior accounts systems assistant. Here is the plan: set the posting rules, trace the errors in the ledger, then test the fixes and hand over.

speaker: Narrator
text: You will be assessed on posting rules, ledger and trial balance skills, error correction, testing, and your explanation. Speed is not scored. All figures are fictional.
spoken: You will be assessed on posting rules, ledger and trial balance skills, error correction, testing, and your explanation. Speed is not scored. All figures are fictional.

speaker: Narrator
text: Press Start when you are ready.
spoken: Press Start when you are ready.

speaker: Grace
text: Some of these look wrong to me, but I cannot tell why. What should the system be doing?
spoken: Some of these look wrong to me, but I cannot tell why. What should the system be doing?

speaker: Narrator
text: Open the rule sheet and look at what the system posted for each sample transaction. Then decide your first debugging action.
spoken: Open the rule sheet and look at what the system posted for each sample transaction. Then decide your first debugging action.

speaker: Grace
text: The system will not let me close the month. It has parked the difference in a suspense account, but nobody knows what it is.
spoken: The system will not let me close the month. It has parked the difference in a suspense account, but nobody knows what it is.

speaker: Narrator
text: The corrected rules apply to new postings. But the first run left errors in the ledger. Start by listing each account balance in the debit or credit column.
spoken: The corrected rules apply to new postings. But the first run left errors in the ledger. Start by listing each account balance in the debit or credit column.

speaker: Grace
text: The books balance now. How do I know the system will not make the same mistakes next month?
spoken: The books balance now. How do I know the system will not make the same mistakes next month?

speaker: Narrator
text: Choose test cases that cover typical transactions, the rules you set, the faults found in the ledger, and one case where the trial balance could balance but the entry is wrong. Predict first, then run, then compare, then revise.
spoken: Choose test cases that cover typical transactions, the rules you set, the faults found in the ledger, and one case where the trial balance could balance but the entry is wrong. Predict first, then run, then compare, then revise.

speaker: Grace
text: Now every entry has two sides, and the system tells me when something is off.
spoken: Now every entry has two sides, and the system tells me when something is off.

speaker: Narrator
text: The debrief panel shows your final score, your test report, and the decisions that shaped them.
spoken: The debrief panel shows your final score, your test report, and the decisions that shaped them.

speaker: Grace
text: Thank you for staying with the numbers until they made sense.
spoken: Thank you for staying with the numbers until they made sense.

speaker: Narrator
text: Trace the difference. You compared the ledger with its source records and corrected the errors behind the KSh 14,100 difference.
spoken: Trace the difference. You compared the ledger with its source records and corrected the errors behind the 14,100 shilling difference.

speaker: Narrator
text: Test beyond the totals. Equal debit and credit totals can still hide a wrong-account posting. Your tests checked both the amounts and the accounts.
